villiger--villiger-1888-nicaragua.description: Launched in 2022 as the Nicaraguan successor to the first handmade premium cigar to bear the Villiger name, this blend is rolled at the Villiger de Nicaragua factory together with Joya de Nicaragua. An Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and fillers from Nicaragua and Pennsylvania. It smokes medium and rounded, with leather and pepper giving way to milk chocolate and honey.

thirds.notes: Pepper opens the nose over nutty, creamy smoke, with a base of earth and lightly roasted coffee.
A burnt-honey sweetness comes forward with milk chocolate, and a mild spice settles in around the midpoint.
Honey leads while chocolate grows toward the nub, over darker wood and earth as the smoke gains weight.

sources.title: Stogie Press – Villiger 1888 Nicaragua Toro review

villiger--villiger-1888-dominican-republ.description: Named for the year the company was founded, the 1888 was the first handmade premium cigar to carry the Villiger name, composed by Heinrich Villiger and made in the Dominican Republic. An Ecuadorian wrapper and Mexican binder hold Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers. Medium in strength, it is creamy and malty, with chocolate, espresso and a pepper that builds slowly.

sources.title: Cigar Reviews by the Katman – Villiger 1888 review

villiger--villiger-1888-gran-reserva.description: A limited box-pressed toro rolled at Villiger's own factory in Estelí, the Gran Reserva wraps Nicaraguan filler and an Ecuadorian binder in a dark Mexican San Andrés leaf. Its tobaccos rest two years before rolling and a further year afterwards. It opens with pepper over chocolate and cream, then turns woody and leathery as the strength builds.

thirds.notes: Black pepper over chocolate, soon joined by cream and dark espresso, with a savoury, spicy edge on the lips.
Wood and leather take over with a gentle warming spice, and the blend gains bite while staying balanced.
Earthy and leathery to the close, dense and even, with no bitter turn at the end.

sources.title: Stogie Press – Villiger 1888 Gran Reserva Box Pressed Toro review

villiger--villiger-1492.description: Named for Columbus's 1492 voyage, which brought tobacco to Europe, this Dominican long-filler line pairs a bright Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper with an Indonesian binder and Dominican filler. The smoke is gentle and aromatic, built on wood, toasted notes and a fine nuttiness, with light coffee and cocoa in some formats. A calm choice for the daytime.

sources.title: Villiger – press release, 1492 in a new dress

villiger--villiger-do-brasil.description: A maduro robusto made in Brazil's Bahia region, where selected torcedoras roll each cigar by hand. Villiger oversees the whole process there, from the tobacco seed to the finished cigar. Sold in packs of five, it is medium in strength and fits a pause of around forty minutes.

villiger--villiger-la-meridiana.description: Named after a historic Havana cigar factory and sold in Europe since 1998, La Meridiana is a Nicaraguan puro whose wrapper goes through an ageing process of about four years; it reached the United States in 2019. The smoke is balanced and earthy, moving from pepper and wood towards cocoa, coffee and a soft vanilla sweetness.

thirds.notes: Black pepper and earth open over wood, with a touch of citrus zest and a salty leather edge.
Oak and sweet spice come forward with vanilla caramel, a nutty element and roasted coffee.
Cocoa and vanilla appear late as the flavours spread and soften over a base of wood and earth.

sources.title: Villiger La Meridiana US introduction (press release)
Stogie Press – Villiger La Meridiana Box Pressed Toro review

villiger--villiger-san-doro-claro.description: Villiger's San'Doro Claro wraps a balanced blend of Nicaraguan tobaccos in a light Claro leaf, offered as a toro and a churchill in packs of three. The smoke is soft and gently spiced, with mild earthy and woody roasted notes and a light creaminess, full in body and well blended.

villiger--villiger-san-doro-colorado.description: The Colorado edition of Villiger's San'Doro is a complex, refined Nicaraguan blend offered as a robusto, toro and churchill. The maker describes it as powerful and intense, with plenty of spice and aromatic depth, yet rounded and soft on the palate. A cigar for an unhurried evening.

villiger--villiger-de-nicaragua.description: A limited series made at Villiger's own factory in Estelí, Nicaragua, with one new format a year since the Gran Toro of 2022: a Perfecto followed, then a Gran Churchill, a Torpedo and, for 2026, a Gordo. Each is made in small numbers and packed in boxes of ten in high-gloss lacquered wood painted with Nicaraguan landscapes.

villiger--villiger-miami.description: Named after Villiger's Miami office, the Generoso is a 7 x 49 Dominican cigar that the company has offered to friends, customers and colleagues visiting that office since early 2021, now released as a limited edition. Medium in strength, it is a long smoke of close to an hour and a half.

villiger--villiger-export.description: A Swiss-made pressed cigar from Villiger, the Export wraps a blend of Brazilian and Caribbean tobaccos in a fine Indonesian leaf. At about four inches and fifteen minutes, it is a short smoke with a spicy character; the Brazil version is the stronger of the range, and a maduro version is offered alongside.

villiger--villiger-kiel.description: Invented in 1907 by Louise Villiger, the Kiel is known as the first cigar with a mouthpiece: originally a goose quill, today a yellow plastic tip. Made in Switzerland with an Indonesian wrapper over selected tobacco, it comes as a Junior Sumatra and a longer Sumatra, for fifteen to twenty-five minutes of smoke.

villiger--villiger-premium-special.description: A Swiss-made range of short cigars from Villiger, each with its own leaf and blend: Indonesian or Sumatra wrappers over South American, Central American and Brazilian fillers, a Brazilian-wrapped No 7 Brasil, and a No 8 Aromatic with pipe tobacco in the filler. Styles run from mild and light to spicy, nutty and full-flavoured, most within fifteen to twenty-five minutes.

villiger--villiger-premium-no-6.description: A slim Swiss-made cigarillo of 96 mm in two versions: the No 6 Honey, with a natural Ecuadorian wrapper, a sweet honey aroma and a mild taste, and the No 6 Sumatra, with a smooth natural wrapper, a harmonious aromatic flavour and a plastic filter tip. Each smokes in about fifteen minutes.

villiger--villiger-45er-sumatra.description: A traditional Swiss-made short cigar of 114 mm, the 45er combines Brazilian and Caribbean tobaccos under a premium Indonesian wrapper. It is smooth and gently spicy, medium in strength, and sold in packs of one hundred for a quick fifteen-minute smoke between other moments of the day.

villiger--villiger-original-krumme.description: Villiger's Original-Krumme is made in Switzerland from three dampened cigars braided by hand and dried in that curved shape, using spicy Virginia tobacco and fitted with a mouthpiece. The curve is meant to cool the smoke so the tobacco aroma can open fully. A thinner, shorter Junior offers the same character in about twenty minutes.

villiger--villiger-premium-cigarillo.description: A filter cigarillo from Villiger in two styles. The Black Filter has an Indonesian wrapper, with a sweetened mouthpiece at the heart of its blend and black-brown striped filter paper with a gold ring. The Red Filter uses a blend of US tobaccos with a hint of vanilla, and can be smoked with or without its filter.

villiger--villiger-cortos.description: Villiger Cortos are short cigarillos in four styles. The Sweets Filter has a natural Ecuadorian wrapper and a slightly sweetened mouthpiece, while the Fino Filter, also Ecuadorian-wrapped, carries rum and vanilla notes with a velvety taste. The Original, with or without a filter, has a more expressive tobacco character.

villiger--villiger-shots.description: Villiger Shots are flavoured cigarillos sold in a metal case whose logo glows in the dark. Melicious pairs a harmonious tobacco blend with honeydew melon and a matching sweetened mouthpiece, while Bluetastic sets a mild blend against fruity blueberry, rounded off by a fruity sweetness at the tip.
